[[Stardew:Incubator|Incubator]] }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Stardew:Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|Farm Building]] that can be purchased from [[Stardew:Carpenter's Shop|Robin]] at the Carpenter's Shop, once players have constructed the [[Stardew:Coop|Deluxe Coop]]. External building colors can be changed by utilizing Robin's construction menu. When the player owns at least one premium coop, [[Goose|Geese]] are unlocked for purchase in [[Stardew:Marnie's Ranch|Marnie's shop]]. Unlike the [[Stardew:coop|big coop]] and [[Stardew:coop|deluxe coop]] upgrades in the base game, the premium coop is an independent building. ==Construction== Construction requires the following materials and takes Robin 4 days to complete. * {{Price|200000}} * {{Name|Fir Wax|20}} * {{NameSDV|Hardwood|125}} * {{NameSDV|Stone|600}} ==Features== The premium coop is a 9x4 building that takes 36 tiles for 16 animals. It has 6 open tiles that allow object placement after being built, 3 near the door entrance and 3 behind the entrance structure. Mathematically, the premium coop has a space-per-animal efficiency of '''2.25''', which means each animal that lives in the premium coop would occupy 2.25 tiles of space on the farm. ===Interior=== The inside of the premium coop measures 26x8 tiles. Including the entrance, it has 148 free spaces for object placement. The premium coop comes with an [[Stardew:Auto-Grabber|auto-grabber]], an [[Stardew:Auto-Petter|auto-petter]], and a [[Stardew:Heater|heater]] placed inside, with a built-in [[Stardew:Hay Hopper|autofeed]] system. * [[Stardew:Feeding Bench|Feeding Bench]] * [[Stardew:Hay Hopper|Hay Hopper]] ==Animals== {|class="wikitable" |- ! Name |- | [[File:Goose side.png|center]] || [[Goose]] |- |colspan="2"| Any [[Stardew:Animals#Coop Animals|Coop Animals]] |} ==vs. [[Stardew:coop|Deluxe Coop]]== The [[Stardew:coop|deluxe coop]] in the base game has space-per-animal efficiency of '''1.5''' and interior space of 101 tiles. Should the player seek to save farm spaces for more animals, deluxe coops would be better suited for this role. Do note that the player needs to own at least one premium coop to unlock [[Goose]] in Marnie's shop. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
